body: ac-01: full-label-space drift report — rate-normalised diff of two Sense snapshots, abs floor + rel multiple, ranked, GO/NO-GO. Validate: must surface geography.coordinate.latitude on v19_clean vs v24_clean.
scripts/drift_report.py + evidence output/destination-drift-precheck/drift_v19_v24_clean.json. Flags coordinate.latitude (4.4x) + longitude on v19_clean vs v24_clean. Committed.
ac-04: calibrate abs-floor + rel-mult so v23 categorical explosion + v24 latitude explosion trip, but v19-vs-v19 reseed negative control gives GO. Document thresholds + margin to worst noise mover.

Calibrated band locked as drift_report.py defaults: --abs-floor 0.0040, --rel-mult 3.0, --direction up. v23 categorical (+6.13pp/4.10x) and v24 latitude (+0.64pp/5.65x) trip NO-GO; v19 s42->s43 model-seed control gives GO. Margins documented in output/destination-drift-precheck/calibration.md + drift_{control,v23,v24}.json.
